description:
Four agent seats show an active assignment to users who are not active workspace members (seats 1, 2, 16, 24 on both instances) (LOW)

What happened (2026-10-24, MCP as team07, read-only):
- endpoint.crm.owners (GET /api/crm/owners, Release 13) lists "the active members of this
  workspace": Keystone 32, Suryodaya 30. It includes Team 03-15, 17-23, 25, 27 (and 26 on
  Keystone), but not Team 01, 02, 16 or 24.
- AgentSeat.list: seats 1 (Ledger Agent), 2 (AR Agent), 16 (Asset Agent) and 24 (Approvals Agent)
  have is_active true, assignment_active true and an assigned_user_id, assigned 2026-09-17:
  Keystone 4420de60, 986f7db6, e683923b, b7561cd1; Suryodaya 822a7ac0, 595f5152, 264723ab, 93871666.
  None of these ids is in the owners list. Every other assigned seat (22 on Keystone, 23 on
  Suryodaya) resolves to a listed member.

Expected: when a user is deactivated or removed from the workspace, their seat assignment ends
(assignment_active false), or the seat reports the assignee as inactive. The two endpoints should
agree on who is active.
Impact: the seat directory shows four core seats (two accounting seats, Assets, Approvals) as
staffed when nobody active holds them, so escalations and hand-offs routed to "the seat's user"
go to a dead account. Low, because we can't see whether anything routes on assigned_user_id today.
